en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of a steel truss bridge spanning a river, with a man standing on floating logs among the rapids. The caption at the top reads 'Bergeforsen, Timmerflottning,' indicating the scene is related to log driving on the Bergeforsen rapids. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, an address to Herr Adolf Wästerlund at Lasarettet (the hospital) in Umeå, and a 10 öre Swedish stamp with a postmark.
